title: Management of Premenstrual Disorders: ACOG Clinical Practice Guideline No. 7
organization_or_journal: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) / Obstetrics & Gynecology
primary_topics: PMS; PMDD; mood; functional impairment; clinical escalation
scope_or_cautions: Clinical guideline for premenstrual disorders. Kira should use it for education and escalation boundaries, not diagnosis or treatment instructions.

title: Premenstrual Syndrome (PMS)
organization_or_journal: American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG)
primary_topics: PMS symptoms; symptom timing; PMDD distinction; symptom tracking
scope_or_cautions: Useful for symptom examples and patient-friendly wording. Some lifestyle/diet suggestions on the page should not be converted into causal blood-glucose claims.

title: PMS (premenstrual syndrome)
primary_topics: PMS; PMDD; symptom variability; safety escalation
scope_or_cautions: Use for general symptom and help-seeking guidance. Do not use to diagnose PMS/PMDD from app data.

title: The Normal Menstrual Cycle and the Control of Ovulation
primary_topics: Cycle definition; follicular phase; ovulation; luteal phase; FSH; LH; estradiol; progesterone
scope_or_cautions: Core physiology source. Textbook phase descriptions are population-level physiology, not measurements of an individual user’s hormone concentrations.

title: The FIGO Ovulatory Disorders Classification System
organization_or_journal: Fertility and Sterility / International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics (FIGO)
primary_topics: Cycle frequency; cycle regularity; ovulatory disorders; terminology
scope_or_cautions: Use FIGO normal menstrual parameters for reproductive-age adults. Age-specific adolescent guidance should be used for teens.

title: The Menstrual Cycle and Sleep
primary_topics: Sleep across cycle; premenstrual sleep; menstrual pain; subjective sleep quality
scope_or_cautions: Sleep effects vary across individuals and studies; objective sleep-stage changes in healthy users are often small or inconsistent.

title: Temperature regulation in women: Effects of the menstrual cycle
primary_topics: Core body temperature; luteal phase; progesterone; estradiol; ovulation tracking limitations
scope_or_cautions: Strong physiology evidence for post-ovulatory temperature rise. Temperature change does not prove that a particular user’s insomnia or mood is hormone-caused.

title: The Effect of the Menstrual Cycle on Energy Intake: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
primary_topics: Energy intake; appetite; luteal phase; follicular phase
scope_or_cautions: Group-average evidence in adult participants. Do not convert into calorie prescriptions, weight-control advice, or predictions for individual users or adolescents.

title: Menstrual cycle effects on cognitive performance: A meta-analysis
evidence_weight: High for rejecting universal cognition stereotypes
primary_topics: Cognition; focus; attention; memory; cycle-phase myths
scope_or_cautions: Supports avoiding deterministic claims that cognitive ability meaningfully rises or falls by phase for everyone.

title: The Effects of Menstrual Cycle Phase on Exercise Performance in Eumenorrheic Women: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
primary_topics: Exercise performance; energy; menstrual phase; individual variability
scope_or_cautions: Average effects were trivial and evidence quality/heterogeneity limit universal phase-based recommendations.

title: Effect of breathwork on stress and mental health: A meta-analysis of randomised-controlled trials
scope_or_cautions: Suggests small-to-medium average benefits, with study heterogeneity and quality limitations. Not evidence that breathing treats a clinical disorder or uniquely affects menstrual symptoms.

title: Meditation programs for psychological stress and well-being: a systematic review and meta-analysis
scope_or_cautions: Moderate evidence for some psychological stress outcomes. Do not describe mindfulness as a cure or as a hormone-specific intervention.

title: Depressive disorder (depression)
scope_or_cautions: General mental-health safety source. Kira should not diagnose depression or provide treatment instructions.

title: Anxiety - Every Mind Matters
evidence_weight: Moderate to high for patient-facing self-care and escalation
primary_topics: Anxiety; breathing; mindfulness; diary; daily-life impairment
scope_or_cautions: Use as general wellness guidance. Do not claim anxiety is caused by cycle phase or that self-help replaces clinical care.

title: Suicide prevention
scope_or_cautions: Kira should use only high-level safety escalation logic; do not provide detailed descriptions of self-harm or suicide.
